settings.update.title: Update
settings.update.terminal: Also `daoris update --when-idle|--now|--cancel` — one file, either door.
settings.update.why: A build staged beside this install by publish:desktop --stage is installed when its work allows: nothing new starts, for the drain's bound at most (Agents and sessions), the sessions running end or park, and once no driven session runs, no conversation is mid-turn and no plugin step (a release, a deploy) is in flight, Daoris closes, its launcher puts the build in place, and Daoris starts again. Past the bound new work starts again, and the build installs at the first moment nothing runs. Not now keeps the build staged and lets work go on, for that build only. Update now closes Daoris at once, and each session it cut is carried on after the start. A build that fails its check, or does not come up, is put aside, and the build before it runs. In a terminal, plain daoris update says what is staged and how the last update ended.
settings.update.none: Nothing is staged beside this install.
settings.update.draining: Installs when the work running now ends; nothing new starts meanwhile.
settings.update.nothingRuns: Nothing runs now, so it installs at the next look.
settings.update.waiting: You said Not now: work goes on, and this build waits for your word.
settings.update.deferred: Waited past the drain's bound: new work starts again, and it installs at the first moment nothing runs.
settings.update.stopping: Stopping to install: nothing new starts. Waiting on {{what}}: {{seconds}} s of at most {{bound}} s. Not now ends the wait and work goes on.
settings.update.applying: Installing: Daoris closes and starts again in a moment.
settings.update.refused: Not installed: {{why}} Update now checks it again; the next build staged replaces it.
